title: Cannot infer type of `and`, `or`, and `not` operator on `Variant`
body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.4.1.stable (49a5bc7b6)

### System information

Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (16 threads)

### Issue description

Type inference fails to infer the type of `not x` when `x` is not type annotated or is annotated as `Variant`, even though the `not` operator always yields a value of type `bool`. This is as opposed to the condition of an `if` or `elif` is allowed to be untyped. Unless there are plans to allow users to overload the `not` operator and allow it to return non-bool values (in which case it should also fail to infer unless it's a builtin non-`Object` type), I can see no reason why inference shouldn't succeed.

### Steps to reproduce

```gdscript
func not_inference(x: Variant):
    # Error: Cannot infer the type of "a" variable because the value doesn't have a set type.
    var a := not x
    # Note that the following equivalent lines are accepted and run without issue:
    var b: bool = not x
    var c := false if x else true
```
